brain.lede: {name}: ana buƙatar ƙwaƙwalwa don yin tunani. Zaɓi ɗaya — za ka iya canza ta a kowane lokaci.
brain.quick.title: Fara da danna sau ɗaya
brain.quick.text: Shiga da OpenRouter: asusu kyauta mai ba da damar amfani da ɗaruruwan ƙwaƙwalwa, wasu kyauta.
brain.key.title: Yi amfani da makullin da kake da shi
brain.key.text: Makullinka yana kan wannan na'urar, a ɓoye.
brain.key.open: Buɗe {service}, sannan ka shiga ko ka ƙirƙiri asusu
brain.key.create: Ƙirƙiri sabon makulli a can, sannan ka kwafe shi
brain.key.vertexOn: Buɗe Vertex AI a Google Cloud, sannan ka kunna shi don aikinka
brain.key.account: Buɗe Service accounts, sannan ka ƙirƙiri ɗaya mai matsayin roles/aiplatform.user
brain.key.accountKey: A cikin Keys ɗinsa, ka ƙara makulli a JSON: za a sauke fayil
brain.key.accountFile: Ka zaɓi wannan fayil a ƙasa. Yana aiki har sai ka goge makullin.
brain.local.title: A kan kwamfutarka
brain.local.text: Yi amfani da ƙwaƙwalwar da ke aiki a kan na'urarka, ta Ollama ko LM Studio.
brain.local.hint: A Ollama, ba wannan shafi izini da OLLAMA_ORIGINS={origin}. A LM Studio, kunna CORS.
brain.claude.title: Yi amfani da shirin Claude ɗinka
brain.claude.text: Yana amsawa da shirin Claude Pro ko Max ɗinka, ta Claude Code da aka girka kuma aka shiga a wannan kwamfutar. Yana bi ta “{computer}”, wanda Haɗa ke buɗewa idan a kashe yake.
brain.claude.missing: Ba a girka Claude Code ba ko ba a shiga ba a wannan kwamfutar. Rubuta claude a tashar umarni (terminal) don shiga, sannan ka sake haɗawa.
brain.claude.restart: “{computer}” har yanzu yana aiki da tsohon sigar. Dakatar da shi (Ctrl+C a tashar umarninsa, ko rufe manhajar), sake kunna shi, sannan ka sake haɗawa.
brain.copilot.title: Yi amfani da shirin Copilot ɗinka
brain.copilot.text: Yana amsawa da shirin GitHub Copilot ɗinka, ta Copilot CLI da aka girka kuma aka shiga a wannan kwamfutar. Yana bi ta “{computer}”, wanda Haɗa ke buɗewa idan a kashe yake.
brain.copilot.missing: Ba a girka Copilot CLI ba ko ba a shiga ba a wannan kwamfutar. Rubuta copilot a tashar umarni (terminal), sannan /login don shiga, sannan ka sake haɗawa.
brain.chatgpt.title: Yi amfani da shirin ChatGPT ɗinka
brain.chatgpt.text: Yana amsawa da shirin ChatGPT Plus ko Pro ɗinka: kana shiga ChatGPT ka ba da izinin amfani da shi a nan, kuma saitunan ChatGPT na nuna yawan amfanin. Yana bi ta “{computer}”, wanda ke ajiye shigar a wannan kwamfutar kuma yana buɗewa da farko idan a kashe yake.
brain.chatgpt.declined: ChatGPT bai ba da izinin amfani da shirinka ba. Don ba da izini, sake ci gaba da ChatGPT.
brain.chatgpt.failed: Shiga ChatGPT bai yi nasara ba. Sake gwadawa.
brain.device.text: Na sirri, kyauta, kuma yana aiki ba tare da intanet ba: babu abin da ka rubuta da zai bar wannan kwamfuta.
brain.device.progress: {done} cikin {total}. Za ka iya ci gaba da amfani da wannan shafi.
brain.sameText: Ƙwaƙwalwa ɗaya, a siga ɗaya, don kowane saƙo
brain.onlyText: Babu abin da ka rubuta da zai bar wannan kwamfuta
brain.versionHint: Atomatik na amfani da Mai sauri, Mai wayo ko Mafi kyau gwargwadon bukatar kowane saƙo. Idan kai da kanka ka zaɓi {brain}, yana amsawa da wannan siga:
auto.both: {brain}, gwargwadon bukatar kowane saƙo, da wannan na’urar don duk abin da ke na sirri
auto.uses: A cikin gajimare, Atomatik na amfani da
auto.personal: Duk abin da ke na sirri
auto.offline: Lokacin da ba ka da intanet
auto.steps: A cikin aiki ɗaya, Atomatik na hawa mataki ɗaya idan amsa ba ta isa ba, kuma ba ya sake saukowa; sabon aiki yana farawa daga ƙasa kuma.
